lead_headline: Deadlift PR Rocks the Week as UCF Wins in the Desert

items.headline: Monday's Pull Sets the Tone
items.body: Your correspondent reports a personal record on Monday's Deadlift 5x2: 285 pounds, RX. The same day's Gym WOD came in at 11+3, also RX, and the barbell has been informed it was outvoted. A strong opening to the week.

items.headline: Three Runs, 11.8 Miles, Two-Day Streak
items.body: The ledger shows 3 runs and 11.8 miles this week, up from 9.4 the week before. The longest went 6.2 miles, and the run streak stands at 2 days. Training load reads yellow, which this paper takes as a polite request for an easy day.

items.headline: Picks Desk Banks a Week 12 Winner
items.body: Lakeshore +10.0 came through 30-28 for 0.91 units. Bayou Tech -7.0 is still pending, so no verdict yet. Week 12 stands 1-0 with one to grade, and the season record is 17-12-1, a 58.6% win rate.

items.headline: UCF Wins Out West; Penn State Hosts Rutgers Today
items.body: UCF won 31-24 at Arizona State to move to 7-4, and visits Colorado next Saturday. Penn State, 8-2, hosts Rutgers today, so this desk offers a preview, not a score.

items.headline: Retirees Hand-Build a Library Revival
items.body: A year of patient work by a group of retirees has brought a closed library back to life, and its shelves now hold 4,000 books that neighbours donated. Proof that retirement is mostly a scheduling change for people who fix things.

items.headline: Follow-up: The Otters Are Staying
items.body: As reported Wednesday, otters are back in a river that took two decades to clean. Cameras have now caught them breeding, which is the river's way of leaving a five-star review.

items.headline: A Battery With More Stamina Than Mondays
items.body: A sodium-based cell held on to 90% of its capacity through 10,000 charge cycles in the lab. Cheaper ingredients and a long life could make storing clean power a lot less fussy.

items.headline: Let the Yellow Light Pick Your Sunday
items.body: After a PR and a 6.2-mile long run, readiness sits at yellow. Keep tomorrow easy: a walk, some stretching, and the Daily 10 on in the background, starting with Alice Coltrane.
